title: Bounded Ratios of Lorentzian Polynomials I: The Ternary Theory and Optimal Bounding Constants
summary: We study bounded ratios and optimal bounding constants among the normalized coefficients of ternary Lorentzian polynomials. For every fixed $M$-convex support and in arbitrary degree, we give an explicit presentation of the bounded-ratio cone in terms of quadratic Hessian slices. We then express the optimal bounding constants through a variational formula combining local support functions with linear compatibility constraints between slices.
